summary: Release notes missing after model version promotion (enterprise customer expects customer-visible changelog entry)
description:
Issue summary
- Customer reports a model version promotion occurred for rw-qwen2.5-72b-instruct, but they cannot find any release notes in Console or public docs. They expected a customer-visible changelog entry with category (perf/quality/bugfix/etc), any breaking changes, and rollback guidance.

Customer context
- Company: Lattice Health Systems (enterprise)
- Deployment: Dedicated evaluation + Hosted API in parallel (per CS notes)
- Why it matters: They have internal change-management requirements and need an auditable record of model changes for clinical workflow reviews. This was flagged as a blocker for expanding traffic to the newer version.

Impact
- No functional outage. Customer trust/operational confidence impacted; they paused rollout to the promoted version.
- Support unable to point to an authoritative customer-visible entry; only internal promotion event existed.

Environment
- Console: prod (us-east)
- Docs: public release notes site

Observed behavior
- Console > Model Catalog > rw-qwen2.5-72b-instruct > Release notes: latest promotion shows “No release notes available”.
- Public docs release notes feed: no entry for the promotion timestamp.

Expected behavior
- On version promotion, a release note should be generated from model metadata + promotion event and visible in Console (customer roles) and in docs (if public). If note is embargoed/internal-only, Console should show a safe placeholder explaining why.

Initial triage notes
- Customer provided approximate time window: 2025-10-09 16:10–16:30 PT.
- Support observed internal admin view showed a promotion event, but customer view did not show any corresponding public note.
comments:
[2025-10-09 17:02 PT] Dev Patel (Support) — Opened ticket after Lattice escalation via TAM. Customer quote: “We saw the model version change in our pinned config diff, but there are no release notes. We need to know what changed and whether we should expect output drift.”

[2025-10-09 17:18 PT] Nora Ahmed (Console) — Acknowledged. Asked for: model slug, pinned version(s), region, screenshots. Pulled initial logs for release-notes endpoint for customer org.

[2025-10-09 17:42 PT] Miguel Santos (Enterprise CS) — Confirmed customer pinned to rw-qwen2.5-72b-instruct@1.3.1; promotion was to 1.3.2 on Dedicated pool LAT-DED-03 (us-east) + Hosted alias update. Customer expected entry in Console release notes feed.

[2025-10-09 18:10 PT] Nora Ahmed — Found internal promotion event in control-plane events stream for model rw-qwen2.5-72b-instruct version 1.3.2. No downstream changelog artifact generated for that event ID. Linking Slack threads: #support (sources/slack/support/1743524300.json) and #eng-releases (sources/slack/eng-releases/1743470199.json).

[2025-10-09 18:28 PT] Connor O'Brien (Release Eng) — Hypothesis: generator dropped the event because metadata record missing required public fields (public_summary + category) OR docs build failed to ingest artifact. Noted we recently tightened redaction rules and “required fields” checks are not yet enforced everywhere.

[2025-10-09 19:05 PT] Michael Nguyen (Control Plane) — Checked event payload: promotion emitted correctly. The metadata snapshot referenced by event includes internal_notes and quality_notes but public_summary empty. Generator template expects at least one public entry; otherwise it produces no customer artifact (bug: should produce placeholder + internal-only record).

[2025-10-10 09:12 PT] Nora Ahmed — Confirmed in generator logs: event processed, but rendered output was empty and skipped publish step (treated as no-op). This causes Console feed to show “No release notes available” rather than an explicit “No customer-visible notes for this change” message.

[2025-10-10 10:03 PT] Dev Patel — Updated customer: we’ve identified an issue in our release notes generation pipeline for a specific promotion event; we will publish an entry and follow up with a link and summary.

[2025-10-10 11:20 PT] Quentin Harris (Model Catalog) — Backfilled metadata for rw-qwen2.5-72b-instruct@1.3.2 with a minimal public_summary and category=“Bugfix/Operational”. Marked any sensitive details as internal_only. Requested reprocess of the promotion event.

[2025-10-10 12:04 PT] Nora Ahmed — Reprocessed event; Console now shows release note entry for customer role. Verified RBAC: internal-only fields not visible.

[2025-10-10 12:18 PT] Wei Chen (Docs) — Triggered docs build; public release notes page now includes the entry. Confirmed the URL and RSS/JSON feed updated.

[2025-10-10 13:00 PT] Dev Patel — Sent customer link + summary and noted that the release note is now available in Console. Customer asked for rollback guidance; provided standard guidance and pointed to model pinning controls.

[2025-10-12 09:40 PT] Nora Ahmed — Follow-up: added internal task to change generator behavior to publish a safe placeholder when there are no customer-visible fields (prevents silent missing entries). Also added monitoring proposal: alert if a promotion event doesn’t yield an artifact within 15 minutes.

[2025-10-12 10:15 PT] Dev Patel — Customer confirmed they can see the entry and resumed staged rollout. Closing ticket.
resolution:
Resolved by (1) backfilling model metadata for rw-qwen2.5-72b-instruct@1.3.2 with a customer-visible public_summary and category per release notes style guide, and (2) reprocessing the specific promotion event so the changelog generator published an artifact consumed by Console and docs.

Root cause
- Changelog generator treated promotions with no customer-visible fields (empty public_summary) as a publish no-op, resulting in a missing customer-visible entry rather than an explicit “no customer-visible notes” placeholder.

Customer-facing outcome
- Console release notes feed now contains the entry for the promotion.
- Public docs release notes page updated and validated.

Workaround (if reoccurs before fix)
- Backfill required public fields on the model version metadata and reprocess the promotion event to regenerate artifacts.
customer_message_sent: We identified an issue where a model promotion event could fail to generate a customer-visible release note if the public summary fields were empty. We’ve published the release note for rw-qwen2.5-72b-instruct v1.3.2 and it should now be visible in your Console and on the public release notes page. We’ve also queued a fix so future promotions will always produce a visible entry (or a clear placeholder if no customer-visible details are applicable).
follow_ups: File engineering bug: generator should publish a safe placeholder entry when only internal-only notes exist (prevents missing artifacts).
Add monitoring/alerting: promotion event without changelog artifact within SLA window (15–30 min).
Expand CI enforcement so promotions cannot proceed with empty public_summary unless explicitly marked internal_only with approved placeholder behavior.
Document expected behavior in support runbook (what support should check: event exists, artifact exists, RBAC visibility).
